title: Magnetic-Bead cDNA Capture from Barcoded Lysate

steps.title: Lysate pretreatment
steps.source_text: Thaw previously frozen lysate, check for precipitation, briefly centrifuge, prepare and add 2.5 uL Capture Enhancer, secure and vortex the tubes, briefly centrifuge, and incubate at room temperature. Begin bead preparation during this incubation as directed by the source.
steps.execution_notes: Benchmark scheduling choice: prepare beads (S2-S3) before lysate pretreatment, then add the prepared beads in S4 immediately after the 10-minute incubation. The source specifies bead preparation during that incubation. Existing standalone sep brief spins are retained. Preparation/equipment confirmations, gentle enhancer pipetting, and precipitation check plus one 5-minute 37C retry gate downstream processing.

steps.title: Streptavidin bead washing
steps.source_text: Mix and aliquot Streptavidin Beads, magnetically separate and discard the supernatant, then perform three Bead Wash Buffer washes with full resuspension, magnetic clearing, and supernatant removal.
steps.execution_notes: Each of four magnetic removals requires a clear-supernatant readout; one authored 1-minute magnetic wait/recheck is allowed, then failed checks stop dependent operations without discarding contents.

steps.title: Preparation of beads in Binding Buffer
steps.source_text: Remove the washed beads from the magnet, fully resuspend in Binding Buffer, and store at room temperature.
steps.execution_notes: Prepared beads remain at the room-temperature input/handling boundary; the existing volume representation is retained, as documented in source.md.

steps.title: cDNA capture
steps.source_text: Add 50 uL beads in Binding Buffer to each lysate, secure and vortex the tubes, then mix for 30 minutes at room temperature with the specified bead-suspension check. Remove the tubes, briefly vortex, and briefly centrifuge without pelleting the beads.
steps.execution_notes: Suspension is checked at minute 10. Successful mixing is 10+20 minutes at 800rpm or 10 minutes at 800rpm plus 1+19 minutes at 1000rpm with a passing retry. An authored 5-second vortex and 100g/8-second standalone sep model the final brief operations without pelleting beads.

steps.title: Magnetic collection of captured cDNA
steps.source_text: Place the tubes at the high magnet position until the supernatant is completely clear, then remove and discard the supernatant while retaining the beads.
steps.execution_notes: Preserve the existing bound/flowthrough fates for cDNA capture. High-position setup and clear-supernatant readouts gate discard, with one authored 1-minute wait/recheck.

steps.title: Wash Buffer 1 washes
steps.source_text: Perform two Wash Buffer 1 washes, each with removal from the magnet, full resuspension in 125 uL buffer, a 1-minute room-temperature incubation, magnetic clearing, and supernatant removal.
steps.execution_notes: Both magnetic wash removals require high-position setup and clear-supernatant readouts, with one authored 1-minute wait/recheck each; failed checks prevent further washing.

steps.title: Final resuspension and handoff
steps.source_text: Remove the tubes from the magnet, fully resuspend each bead pellet in 125 uL Wash Buffer 2, incubate for 1 minute at room temperature, and proceed immediately to Section 2.2. Save Wash Buffer 2 for optional storage before amplification.
steps.execution_notes: Runs only after prior checks pass. CaptureWorkflowStatus distinguishes completed capture from partial material; this standalone case does not execute Section 2.2.

source_version: Evercode WT Mega v3; UMWT3500; version 1.5; November 2024
